items.detail: apply_R1_R2_R3.commit() copied each file to its .bak AFTER writing the edit, so the four backups were post-edit copies; and config/ is not tracked by git, so HEAD held no preimage either
the projection note written by the projection-repair pass was an unquoted YAML plain scalar containing ": ", which made the whole registry unparseable
the structured rewrite of the VERIFY chain dropped a field the registry binds, so the binding resolved to nothing
the guard refuses ANY same-model maker/checker pair (exit 2) and never consults the registry's declared_conflicts, so the owner's mandate was undispatchable

items.disposition: OPEN - recorded, not papered over; the round does NOT invent a producer
items.detail: ADMITTED is accepted only from a receipt FILE, and nothing in the product produces one (only tests do), so the gate can refuse but never admit
the whole-tree enumeration obstruction is a LONG-PATH failure (WinError 3), not access-denied as the previous round recorded
items.artifact: this round hit the same failure class in its own preimage search and handled it with an onerror-tolerant walk
